thread:
Nora: Heads-up, eu-west1 is showing a weird micro-pod orbit pattern this morning — lots of 0.25/0.5 GPU pods stuck Pending while some nodes report >85% reserved. Latency for small inferences up ~1.8x. Anyone digging? :thinking:
Ravi: I see it. Heap of tiny pods trying to land but scheduler prefers nodes with free contiguous cards. fragmentation_index jumped in the last 30m.
Hannah: Noticed a change to the warm-pool policy last night that excluded nodes with k8s.gpu.reserved=true. If warm pools are off for the shared pool, cold-starts increase and packing gets worse.
Nora: I pulled scheduler logs, seeing repeated attach/detach and soft-evictions: ```E0414 07:05:12 scheduler/pack.go:87] pack failed: insufficient contiguous gpus. E0414 07:05:12 attach-detach: detach timeout, retry```
Leo: We also had a small autoscaler bug that paused scaledown for 20m around 06:50 — could cause weird headroom signals. Link: https://deploys.redwood/autoscaler/3819
InfraBot: @channel Alert: eu-west1 fragmentation_index > threshold for AZ-b. Warm-pool scaling suspended at 07:02 for config rollback.
Ravi: Ops theory: reserved Dedicated pools + autoscaler pause + warm-pool exclusion = fragmented islands. Tiny pods can't binpack into leftover fractional GPUs.
Hannah: Short-term mitigations we can do quickly: 1) temporarily allow warm-pool to include non-Reserved nodes 2) run targeted descheduler with conservative eviction policy 3) add a scheduler hint label fractional.gpu=true to prefer coalescing.
Nora: Agreed. Also propose a non-invasive descheduler canary: label selector workload=shared-infer and limit nodes=4. Evict policy: target utilization <40% and age >5m. No rollout to Dedicated pool nodes.
Leo: I'll flip warm-pool include flag and roll a small change to autoscaler rollback. Will notify in 2m.
InfraBot: warm-pool include flag toggled + autosc rollback applied (id: revert-3819) at 07:12.
Ravi: Kicking descheduler canary now: job id compact-eu1-canary, nodes: node-a3,node-b7,node-b9,node-c2. Policy: avoid draining customer-dedicated nodes.
Hannah: Also pushed a quick scheduler preference tweak: binpack-favor=high for pods with label fractional.gpu=true. No code change, config only.
Nora: Customer impact note: we must coordinate with CS before touching any node with k8s.gpu.reserved=true. We'll limit descheduler to nodes without that label. Hannah, can you add that check to the job?
Hannah: Done. Canary logs: reclaimed 5 fractional slots, pending small-pods dropped from 36 -> 9 on canary nodes. No customer-facing evictions.
Leo: Nice. I'll keep warm-pool enabled for 30m and watch tail-latency. If stable, plan gradual descheduler run across AZs with rate 1% nodes per 10m.
Ravi: Also creating a short-lived metric alert for attach-detach retry rate to catch regressions.
Nora: Thanks all. Action items: Leo monitor warm-pool + autoscaler, Hannah finalize descheduler playbook, Ravi add attach-detach alert, I'll draft CS note if we need to touch Dedicated nodes.
InfraBot: Incident: fragmentation mitigations deployed (warm-pool toggle + descheduler canary). Monitoring for 60m.
